from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import ast,difflib,hashlib,json,subprocess
task=Path("reports/T0008");out=task/"review-r2-freeze"
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
prior=json.loads((task/"review-r1/final-audit.json").read_text())
old=json.loads((task/"review-r1-freeze/audit.json").read_text())
head=subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()
assert head==prior["head"]
mutable={"tests/test_derivations.py","README.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/handoffs/T0008-ground-derivations.md"}
for p,h in old["history_sha256"].items():assert sha(p)==h,p
for p,h in prior["artifact_sha256"].items():
    if p not in mutable:assert sha(p)==h,p
assert sha("src/kmesh/logic/derivations.py")==prior["reviewed_files"]["src/kmesh/logic/derivations.py"]
base=json.loads((task/"planning-baseline.json").read_text())
for p,h in base["source_sha256"].items():
    if h is not None:assert sha(p)==h,p
before=(task/"review-r1-freeze/input-snapshot/tests/test_derivations.py").read_text()
after=Path("tests/test_derivations.py").read_text()
(out/"tests.diff").write_text("".join(difflib.unified_diff(before.splitlines(True),after.splitlines(True),fromfile="R1/tests/test_derivations.py",tofile="R2/tests/test_derivations.py")))
def functions(s):return {n.name:ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in ast.parse(s).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)}
bf,af=functions(before),functions(after)
changed=sorted(k for k in bf.keys()|af.keys() if bf.get(k)!=af.get(k))
inputs=["src/kmesh/logic/derivations.py","tests/test_derivations.py","README.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/handoffs/T0008-ground-derivations.md","reports/T0008/pi-r2-full/provenance.md","reports/T0008/pi-r2-scripts/check_docs.py"]
ih={}
for p in inputs:
    dest=out/"input-snapshot"/p;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_bytes(Path(p).read_bytes());ih[p]=sha(p)
runs=[]
for p in sorted(task.glob("pi-r2-*/record.json")):
    r=json.loads(p.read_text())
    assert r["status"]=="finished" and r["exit_code"]==0,p
    assert r["before"]["source_sha256"]==r["after"]["source_sha256"],p
    for q,h in r["before"]["source_sha256"].items():
        if q=="tests/test_derivations.py" and p.parent.name=="pi-r2-preflight":
            assert h==prior["reviewed_files"][q]
        else:assert sha(q)==h,(p,q)
    for stream in ("stdout","stderr"):assert sha(p.parent/(stream+".txt"))==r[stream+"_sha256"],p
    runs.append({"run":p.parent.name,**{k:r[k] for k in ("argv","exit_code","elapsed_s","started_at_utc","finished_at_utc")},"stdout_tail":(p.parent/"stdout.txt").read_text()[-110:],"stderr":(p.parent/"stderr.txt").read_text()})
assert len(runs)==6
history={str(p):sha(p) for p in task.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and not any(x in p.parts for x in ("pytest-tmp","__pycache__")) and not str(p).startswith(str(out))}
audit={"created_at_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"head":head,"input_sha256":ih,"history_sha256":history,"changed_test_functions":changed,"pi_r2_runs":runs,"old_review_and_pi_files_unchanged":True}
(out/"audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(audit,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print("PASS: original product, prior sources/review/history and all six R2 RUN streams verified")
print(json.dumps({"input_sha256":ih,"changed_test_functions":changed,"pi_r2_runs":runs,"history_files":len(history)},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

import ast,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
out=Path("reports/T0008/review-r2-isolation-probe")
tree=ast.parse(Path("tests/test_derivations.py").read_text())
script=next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=="ISOLATION_SCRIPT" for t in n.targets))
needle="for name in sorted(sys.modules):"
assert script.count(needle)==1
results={}
for name,code,want in (
    ("original",script,0),
    ("forbidden_submodule",script.replace(needle,"import types\nsys.modules['kmesh.logic.engine.review_hidden'] = types.ModuleType('kmesh.logic.engine.review_hidden')\n"+needle),1),
):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-c",code],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
    (out/(name+".stdout")).write_text(p.stdout)
    (out/(name+".stderr")).write_text(p.stderr)
    assert p.returncode==want,(name,p.stdout,p.stderr)
    if want:assert "blocked module present: kmesh.logic.engine.review_hidden" in p.stderr
    else:assert "ISOLATION_OK" in p.stdout
    results[name]={"exit_code":p.returncode,"result":"PASS" if not want else "rejected_by_submitted_scan"}
(out/"findings.json").write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
